{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ways and Means Committee room''' was a room on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] that was used by the [[Cularin Government]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] attended a meeting in the Committee room, to discuss the implications of some data that had been recovered from the [[Believers|Believer]] [[Gura Tran]] during a [[Mission to the Ando system|mission]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]].
